title: Ruuhu Watchful to daande maayo
intro: Ruuhu cukalel halfinaama golle sirlu, ngam ndaarde gila e woɗɗude no daɗndo ngoo ƴellitortoo e dow ndiyam ɗam. Ndeeɗoo limoore nde yiyaaka, nde sikkaaka, ina jogori waɗde darnde tiiɗnde e waylude ngonka daartol ngenndi.
clues: Mi rokkaama golle yumma am, ɗe njiɗi ko wujjude e jeertaade.
Gite am ina njokki e ŋoral tokosal ina ɓuuɓtoo e dow ŋoral, ɓernde am ina teddi e kulol.
Nde lannda mo mi sikkaano tawi nde, mi ɓadtii, miɗo heewi kulol.
Mi yiyii ŋakkeende maɓɓe e toppitiiɗo, mi rokki ɗum feere tawa mi hollitaani goonga.
Naatgol am e sahaa mum addani mi ruuhu ɓuuɓɗo ruttaade e ɓurɗo haajde.
E nder ñaawirɗe doole, mi haali: “Mbele miɗo ardoo ma e galle mo ñamlata mo, toppitiiɗo mo e hakkille?”

outcome.answer: O hawriti cukalel ngel e yumma mum

arabic: ۞ وَحَرَّمْنَا عَلَيْهِ ٱلْمَرَاضِعَ مِن قَبْلُ فَقَالَتْ هَلْ أَدُلُّكُمْ عَلَىٰٓ أَهْلِ بَيْتٍۢ يَكْفُلُونَهُۥ لَكُمْ وَهُمْ لَهُۥ نَـٰصِحُونَ
verse: And We had prevented from him [all] wet nurses before, so she said, "Shall I direct you to a household that will be responsible for him for you while they are to him [for his upbringing] sincere?" (28:12)
